theater: 科威特與伊拉克南部沙漠

battle.name: 波斯灣戰爭
battle.theater: 科威特與伊拉克南部沙漠
battle.brief: 1990年8月2日伊拉克以逾十萬兵力入侵科威特，兩日攻陷首都；安理會第678號決議授權多國部隊動武，1991年1月17日聯軍發動「沙漠風暴」空襲，四十日後地面部隊自科威特以西大迂迴，2月28日迫使伊軍停火。卡面1985年列裝的M1A1主力戰車，正是聯軍第七軍裝甲縱隊的突擊主力。

kit.name: M1A1主力戰車
kit.history: 1985年列裝的美軍主力戰車，1991年地面作戰期間配屬聯軍裝甲部隊，用於前線突擊與對抗對方戰車。

countries: 交戰方分成兩大集團。以美國為首的聯軍一方由三十二個國家組成，除美軍外還包括加拿大、英國、法國、西班牙、義大利、丹麥、挪威、比利時、荷蘭、澳洲、紐西蘭、匈牙利、捷克斯洛伐克等北約與其他成員國，以及沙烏地阿拉伯、科威特、埃及、敘利亞、摩洛哥、卡達、聯合大公國、巴林、阿曼、塞內加爾、孟加拉、巴基斯坦等阿拉伯與伊斯蘭國家。聯軍的指揮體系分三層：美軍中央司令部司令諾曼·施瓦茨科普夫上將負責整個戰區的統一指揮，中央司令部陸軍司令部由卡爾文·沃勒中將主持，中央司令部空中司令部由查爾斯·霍納中將統籌空中作戰；地面序列則分VII軍、第十八空降軍與第一海軍陸戰隊遠征軍三大縱隊，另有阿拉伯聯合部隊司令部在喬治·克里斯特中將率領下指揮各國地面部隊，最後一輪攻勢中正是這些阿拉伯部隊擔負了地面兵力的主體。伊拉克一方由總統薩達姆·侯賽因以最高統帥身份直接掌握，參謀長希沙姆·阿夫南中將主持全軍運作，入侵科威特的兵員由穆罕默德·穆薩·卡迪姆中將指揮，北部與西部戰區則由侯賽因的表弟阿里·哈桑·馬吉德中將掌控，第四、第七、第十二機械化軍、共和國衛隊與各裝甲師構成其骨幹。
countriesEn: The belligerents fall into two grand coalitions. The coalition led by the United States was made up of thirty-two nations: besides the American force, Canada, the United Kingdom, France, Spain, Italy, Denmark, Norway, Belgium, the Netherlands, Australia, New Zealand, Hungary, Czechoslovakia and other NATO and partner states, together with Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Egypt, Syria, Morocco, Qatar, the United Arab Emirates, Bahrain, Oman, Senegal, Bangladesh and Pakistan among the Arab and Islamic countries. The coalition command had three layers: General H. Norman Schwarzkopf, commander of US Central Command, held unified theatre command; General Calvin Waller ran Central Command Army Component; General Charles Horner commanded Central Command Air Forces and directed the air campaign. On the ground the force was organised into three major groupings, VII Corps, XVIII Airborne Corps and I Marine Expeditionary Force, while the Arab Joint Forces Command under General George Crist directed the contingents of the other countries, and it was those Arab formations that supplied the bulk of the ground manpower in the final offensive. On the Iraqi side President Saddam Hussein took charge directly as supreme commander, Chief of Staff General Hisham Afnan ran the army, the forces that invaded Kuwait were commanded by General Muhammad Musa al-Kadhim, and the northern and western sectors were controlled by Saddam's cousin General Ali Hassan al-Majid; the 4th, 7th and 12th Mechanised Corps, the Republican Guard and the armoured divisions formed the backbone of that force.
people: 關鍵人物橫跨政治決策、戰術指揮與戰地執行三個層面。政治層面上，伊拉克總統薩達姆·侯賽因是整場戰爭的權力核心，他以總統兼最高統帥身份批准入侵計畫，在安理會第678與第689號決議之後仍拒絕撤軍，最後在聯軍地面攻勢與自家軍隊崩潰的雙重壓力下下令停火；科威特埃米爾賈比爾·阿爾艾哈邁德·阿薩巴赫在淪陷後流亡沙特，並在聯軍框架內重建流亡政府；沙烏地阿拉伯國王法赫德與王儲蘇爾坦·本·阿卜杜勒阿齊茲在1990年8月同意接受聯軍進駐本國領土，這是多國部隊得以在短時間內成軍的關鍵；埃及總統胡塞因·穆巴拉克與敘利亞總統哈菲茲·阿薩德則以阿拉伯國家代表身分加入戰局。軍事層面上，美軍中央司令部司令施瓦茨科普夫以VII軍在科威特以西沙漠展開的大迂迴取代正面的強攻，並批准了對伊拉克第三裝甲師指揮部與彈藥庫的定點打擊；空中司令部司令霍納統一規劃空襲，與中央司令部作戰指揮中心負責人厄爾·霍爾就打擊目標次序的分歧，最後由施瓦茨科普夫裁定；第七軍司令弗里德里克·弗蘭克斯中將指揮西線迂迴，第1、第2、第3裝甲師的M1A1縱隊是突擊的矛頭；第十八空降軍司令約翰·約索克中將在北部吸住伊拉克主力，第一海軍陸戰隊遠征軍司令沃爾特·布默中將在東線攻向科威特市；英軍駐中東部隊指揮官彼得·德拉比利埃中將與法國第六輕裝甲師同屬聯軍序列。伊拉克方面，參謀長阿夫南中將主持全軍運作，穆薩·卡迪姆中將統率駐科威特部隊，阿里·哈桑·馬吉德中將指揮北部戰區並下令點燃科威特油井；共和國衛隊司令穆罕默德·阿里·馬吉德上將在沙漠風暴期間遭空襲重傷後身亡，令伊拉克的指揮系統再受震動。
peopleEn: The decisive figures lie on three levels: political decision, operational command and execution on the ground. Politically, Iraqi President Saddam Hussein was the power centre of the whole war; as president and supreme commander he approved the invasion plan, refused to withdraw even after Security Council resolutions 678 and 689, and only ordered a ceasefire when the coalition ground offensive and the collapse of his own army pressed on him from both directions. The Emir of Kuwait, Jaber Al-Ahmad Al-Sabah, went into exile in Saudi Arabia after the fall of his country and rebuilt his government within the coalition framework. The Saudi King Fahd and Crown Prince Sultan bin Abdulaziz agreed in August 1990 to host coalition troops on Saudi soil, and that consent was the key to raising a multi-national force within weeks. Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and Syrian President Hafez al-Assad joined as representatives of the Arab states. At the military level, General Schwarzkopf replaced a frontal assault with the wide turn to the west of the VII Corps, and authorised the precision strikes against the command post and ammunition depot of the Iraqi 3rd Armoured Division. General Horner ran the air campaign as a single plan; his differences with General Earl Hall, who headed the Central Command operations centre, over the order of targets were settled by Schwarzkopf. General Frederick Franks commanded the western hook, with the M1A1 brigades of the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Armoured Divisions forming its spearhead. General John Yeosock's XVIII Airborne Corps pinned the Iraqi main effort in the north, and General Walter Boomer's I Marine Expeditionary Force struck towards Kuwait City in the east. Lieutenant-General Sir Peter de la Billière, commanding British forces in the Middle East, and the French 6th Light Armoured Division belonged to the same coalition order of battle. On the Iraqi side Chief of Staff Hisham Afnan ran the army, Muhammad Musa al-Kadhim commanded the forces in Kuwait, and Ali Hassan al-Majid held the northern sector and gave the order to set the Kuwaiti oil wells alight. The Republican Guard commander, General Muhammad Ali Majid, was badly wounded by air attack during Desert Storm and later died, which shook the Iraqi command structure once more.
kits: 卡面那輛1985年列裝的M1A1主力戰車是本役聯軍地面部隊的骨幹。它換裝120毫米滑膛炮，裝有復合裝甲模組與附加裝甲，作戰全重約六十三噸，發動機為1,500匹馬力燃氣渦輪機；120毫米滑膛炮配尾翼穩定脫穿彈，在約三千五百米距離上對T-72仍保持射擊優勢，熱像瞄具更讓它能在夜戰之中先發現、先開火。編制上，VII軍的第1、第2、第3裝甲師與第4步兵師裝甲旅各配M1A1，一個戰車連為4排×4輛共16輛，連長通常以一輛M1A1兼任指揮車，營、旅層級再設戰車偵察排、迫擊炮排與工兵排。伊軍的主要對手是T-72B與T-72M1，配125毫米滑膛炮與激光測距自動火控，另有大量T-55與T-62；雙方在同樣的沙漠裝甲對決裡，其實共享同一條從二戰一閃電戰理論一路傳下的技術血脈，只是M1A1在觀瞄、動力和火控三方面都換成了新世代。戰役中M1A1大量配發120毫米高爆彈與破甲榴彈用於對付掘壕的T-72，美軍裝甲部隊還曾以降低初速的高爆彈打擊近距掘壕目標，以減少跳彈對自家瞄具的傷害。聯軍空中力量是F-15E「猛禽」雙座戰鬥轟炸機、F-16C/D戰鬥機、A-10「疣豬」攻擊機、F-117隱形攻擊機、B-52同溫層堡壘轟炸機，配KC-135空中加油機與E-3預警機，使用「戰斧」巡弋飛彈、MGM-88「標準」空對地飛彈以及AGM-65「馬維瑞克」與AGM-88「哈姆」反輻射飛彈。伊拉克方面有米格-29、米格-23、米格-25與Su-22、Su-7，地面有T-62、T-55、BM-21「冰雹」多管火箭炮、122毫米與152毫米榴彈炮、S-75「山貓」防空飛彈與「箭」式便攜防空飛彈，另有450毫米「冰雹」式火箭炮但發射紀錄稀少。運輸與後勤方面，聯軍靠戰前預置部署形成以沙特朱拜勒港與達蘭港為核心的海運補給體系，輔以戰地彈藥庫與數千輛各型車輛；科威特境內縱貫南北約八十公里的「死亡高速公路」，正是撤退時被聯軍空軍追擊的伊拉克車隊所在。
kitsEn: The M1A1 main battle tank on the card, fielded in 1985, was the backbone of the coalition ground force. It carried the 120mm smoothbore gun, composite armour modules and add-on armour, weighed some sixty-three tonnes in combat order, and was powered by a 1,500 horsepower gas turbine; the 120mm gun firing fin-stabilised sabot rounds out-ranged the T-72 out to roughly 3,500 metres, and its thermal sights let it detect and shoot first in night fighting. In the order of battle the M1A1 equipped the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Armoured Divisions and the armour brigades of the 4th Infantry Division within VII Corps; a tank company numbered sixteen vehicles in four platoons of four, the company commander normally rode in an M1A1 as command vehicle, and battalion and brigade echelons added tank reconnaissance, mortar and engineer platoons. The principal Iraqi opponent was the T-72B and T-72M1 with its 125mm smoothbore gun and laser-ranged automatic fire control, backed by large numbers of T-55 and T-62. In this meeting of armour in the desert the two sides in fact shared the same technical bloodline running back from the blitzkrieg theory of the Second World War, except that the M1A1 had been rebuilt around new-generation sighting, power and fire-control systems. During the campaign the M1A1 was issued large quantities of 120mm high-explosive and HEAT rounds for dug-in T-72s, and some American tank crews used reduced-velocity high-explosive shells against enemy tanks at close range, cutting down the spalling that could damage their own sights. On the coalition air side the main types were the two-seat F-15E Strike Eagle, the F-16C/D, the A-10 Thunderbolt II, the F-117 Nighthawk and the B-52 Stratofortress, supported by KC-135 tankers and E-3 Sentry aircraft, using Tomahawk cruise missiles, MGM-88 Standard air-to-surface missiles and the AGM-65 Maverick and AGM-88 HARM anti-radiation missiles. Iraq fielded MiG-29s, MiG-23s, MiG-25s and Su-22 and Su-7s, with T-62 and T-55 tanks, BM-21 Grad multiple rocket launchers, 122mm and 152mm howitzers, S-75 Dvina surface-to-air missiles and Strela manpads, plus 450mm Katyusha rocket launchers that were seldom fired. On the logistics side the coalition exploited its pre-positioned stocks to build a sealift system centred on the Saudi ports of Jubail and Dammam, backed by forward ammunition depots and several thousand vehicles of every type; the eighty-kilometre road through Kuwait that ran from Kuwait City to the Iraq border, later called the Highway of Death, was the route along which retreating Iraqi columns were hunted by coalition air power.
tactics: 空襲階段自1991年1月17日夜開始，至2月23日結束，共四十日。聯軍以三十二國兵力實施「沙漠風暴」，總出動量約三萬九千架次，頭一夜最為密集，單夜出動逾一千二百架次，目標是伊拉克的指揮中心、機場、煉油廠與飛彈發射車，配F-117隱形機突防與「戰斧」飛彈攻擊加固目標。空襲按四個階段推進：壓制敵防空與指揮所、摧毀伊拉克空軍、搜毀「飛鏢」系列飛彈發射裝置、孤立科威特城並支援地面部隊；伊拉克的S-75、S-62與「箭」式飛彈在頭幾日被大量消耗，聯盟空軍自此得以在七千米以上高度近乎無阻礙地作戰。地面階段自2月24日拂曉開始，以大規模空軍出動與炮兵準備射擊拉開序幕，第七軍自科威特以西的伊拉克西部沙漠展開左勾拳式的大迂迴，裝甲師縱隊在極寬的正面同時展開而不強求突破，第十八空降軍在北部突破伊拉克第3、第29師防線，第一海軍陸戰隊遠征軍在東線指向科威特市與艾哈邁德·賈比爾煉油廠區，2月26日奪占科威特國際機場，2月27日進入科威特城。伊拉克的反擊集中在兩次：1月29日至30日與2月4日至5日，裝甲師企圖向沙特方向突進，在阿法克方向與聯盟空軍及地面部隊爆發了二戰以來規模最大的裝甲戰之一；2月26日伊軍第3裝甲師反攻時，其指揮部與彈藥庫在十分鐘內被A-10與F-15E精確打擊摧毀，裝甲縱隊因失去補給與指揮而瓦解。整體樣式可歸為縱深打擊、空地協同與裝甲縱隊高速穿插三者的結合。
tacticsEn: The air phase ran from the night of 17 January 1991 to 23 February, forty days in all. The coalition mounted Desert Storm with forces from thirty-two nations for a total of about 39,000 sorties, the heaviest night being the first, with more than 1,200 sorties in a single night, against Iraqi command centres, airfields, refineries and missile launchers, with the F-117s penetrating and Tomahawks striking hardened targets. The campaign moved through four phases: suppression of enemy air defences and command posts, destruction of the Iraqi air force, hunting of the Scud launchers, and isolation of Kuwait City in support of the ground forces. Iraqi S-75, S-62 and Strela missiles were consumed in large numbers during the first days, and from then on the coalition air forces could operate almost without hindrance above seven thousand metres. The ground phase opened before dawn on 24 February with massed air sorties and artillery preparation fire. VII Corps executed a wide left hook through the Iraqi desert to the west of Kuwait, the armoured divisions spreading out across an extremely broad front rather than trying to break through anywhere in particular. XVIII Airborne Corps broke the Iraqi 3rd and 29th Divisions in the north, while I Marine Expeditionary Force struck in the east towards Kuwait City and the Al-Jaber refinery complex, seizing Kuwait International Airport on 26 February and entering the city on 27 February. The Iraqi counter-attacks came in two waves: on 29 and 30 January, and on 4 and 5 February, when armoured divisions tried to push towards Saudi Arabia and fought what is often called one of the largest armoured battles since the Second World War near Afak, against coalition air power and ground troops alike. On 26 February, when the Iraqi 3rd Armoured Division counter-attacked, its command post and ammunition depot were destroyed within ten minutes by precision strikes from A-10s and F-15Es, and the armoured formations fell apart once command and supply were gone. The overall pattern combined strikes deep into the enemy rear, air-ground cooperation and high-speed penetration by armoured columns.
data: 時間線：1990年8月2日凌晨伊拉克入侵科威特，8月上旬美國凍結伊拉克在美資產並實施禁運，8月17日伊拉克宣布兼併科威特，11月29日安理會第689號決議下達1991年1月15日的撤軍限期，1月17日空襲開始，2月24日地面戰爭打響，2月28日伊拉克廣播電台宣布全面停火，3月2日安理會第687號決議確認停火並啟動核查程序。兵力：聯軍總兵力約七十萬人，其中美軍約五十四萬人，各國統計口徑不一；地面序列為VII軍四個師（第1、第2、第3裝甲師與第4步兵師）、XVIII空降軍三個師（兩空降師與第2步兵師）、海軍陸戰隊一個師、英國第一裝甲師、法國第六輕裝甲師，以及沙烏地、埃及、敘利亞、摩洛哥、科威特等二十餘國部隊。伊拉克在入侵時投入約十萬兵力與八百至一千輛坦克，戰役中在科威特一線佈置兵力約四十萬，裝甲師與共和國衛隊為主。火力：空襲階段共出動約三萬九千架次，發射巡弋飛彈約一千八百枚，F-117出動逾一千架次；地面戰爭四天內聯軍空軍摧毀伊拉克坦克與裝甲車數百輛，A-10貢獻最大。損失：聯盟各國死亡合計在數百人量級，其中美軍陣亡一百四十八人；伊拉克軍被俘約六萬五千人，損失坦克與裝甲車以數百輛計，各方公佈數字自數百輛至逾千輛不等，飛機在地面損失數百架。戰線：科威特與沙特邊境正面寬約六百公里，但實際接觸線遠短於此，絕大多數戰鬥集中在科威特西部與西北部走廊。
dataEn: Chronology: Iraq invaded Kuwait in the early hours of 2 August 1990; the United States froze Iraqi assets in America and imposed an embargo in the first days of August, and on 17 August Iraq declared the annexation of Kuwait; Security Council resolution 689 of 29 November set 15 January 1991 as the deadline for withdrawal; the air campaign opened on 17 January, the ground war on 24 February, the Iraqi radio announced a general ceasefire on 28 February, and resolution 687 of 2 March confirmed the ceasefire and opened the inspection process. Manpower: the coalition fielded roughly 700,000 personnel, of whom about 541,000 were American, though national counts vary; the ground order of battle was the four divisions of VII Corps, the 1st, 2nd and 3rd Armoured Divisions and the 4th Infantry Division, the three divisions of XVIII Airborne Corps, two airborne divisions and the 2nd Infantry Division, one Marine division, the British 1st Armoured Division, the French 6th Light Armoured Division, and contingents from more than twenty other countries including Saudi Arabia, Egypt, Syria, Morocco and Kuwait. Iraq committed around 100,000 men and 800 to 1,000 tanks to the invasion and disposed some 400,000 troops along the Kuwaiti front, with the armoured divisions and the Republican Guard as the core. Firepower: about 39,000 sorties were flown in the air phase, some 1,800 cruise missiles were launched, and the F-117s flew more than 1,000 missions; during the four days of the ground war coalition aircraft destroyed several hundred Iraqi tanks and armoured vehicles, with the A-10 contributing the largest share. Losses: coalition fatalities were in the hundreds, of whom 148 were American; about 65,000 Iraqi soldiers were taken prisoner; Iraqi tank and armoured vehicle losses run to several hundred, with published figures ranging from several hundred to well over a thousand; several hundred aircraft were destroyed on the ground. Front: the face along the Kuwaiti-Saudi border was about 600 kilometres wide, but the real line of contact was far shorter, and the overwhelming majority of the fighting was compressed into the western and north-western approaches to Kuwait.
cause: 起因是多層因素的交疊。第一，1980至1988年兩伊戰爭之後，伊拉克背上巨額債務，其中對科威特的借款據不同估算達數十億至百億美元級別；科威特1989年雖曾大額豁免伊債，1990年伊方仍就油價與債務問題向科威特施壓。第二，兩國在邊界劃界與拉馬伊拉油田的產量配額上糾紛不斷，1990年夏天伊拉克指責科威特超產破壞石油輸出國組織的配額、壓低國際油價，並指科威特侵入伊境、掠走軍用裝備，而科方否認此事。第三，1990年國際油價下跌、國內失業與復員兵員安置困難，執政當局需要一場軍事勝利來轉移內部壓力。第四，薩達姆·侯賽因本人在黨內與軍內的權力基礎需要戰爭紅利鞏固，軍方擬定的方案在1990年7月已把入侵的部隊編組、進攻軸線與時限落實，8月2日凌晨突然發動。第五，外部環境同樣有利：冷戰結束令美國對中東的注意力下降，蘇聯解體削弱了對伊拉克的制衡，安理會因海灣國家與阿拉伯勢力的立場而反對意見有限。外交上，這場入侵被包裝成阿拉伯兄弟之間的糾紛，薩達姆在開戰前致函阿拉伯聯盟，聲稱行動只是對科威特「懲戒」性的教訓。
causeEn: The causes were an overlap of several layers. First, the Iran-Iraq War of 1980 to 1988 left Iraq with heavy debts, including loans from Kuwait that different estimates put at anywhere from several billion to tens of billions of dollars. Kuwait had cancelled a large part of the Iraqi debt in 1989, yet in 1990 Baghdad still pressed Kuwait on oil prices and repayment. Second, the two countries were endlessly in dispute over boundary demarcation and over production quotas in the Rumaila oilfield; in the summer of 1990 Iraq accused Kuwait of over-producing in breach of the OPEC quota, depressing world prices, and of having penetrated Iraqi territory to steal military equipment, a charge Kuwait denied. Third, with world oil prices falling in 1990 and unemployment and the resettlement of demobilised soldiers pressing on the regime, the government at home needed a military victory to divert internal strain. Fourth, Saddam Hussein's own position inside the party and the army needed the spoils of a war to be secured, and the military plan had already fixed the force structure, the axis of attack and the timing of the invasion by July 1990, which was launched suddenly in the early hours of 2 August. Fifth, the external environment was favourable: the end of the Cold War had reduced American attention to the Middle East, the dissolution of the Soviet Union weakened the counterweight to Iraq, and in the Security Council there was little opposition because of the positions of the Gulf and other Arab states. Diplomatically the invasion was packaged as a quarrel between Arab brothers; Saddam wrote to the Arab League before the fighting began and described the operation as a corrective and disciplinary lesson for Kuwait.
impact: 影響至少有四層。國際法層面上，安理會第678號決議確立了由安理會授權多國部隊使用武力的實踐，成為冷戰後聯合國最常被援引的樣板；第687號決議則開啟了對伊拉克大規模核查與裁軍的程序，設立伊拉克特別委員會，核查化學武器、飛彈與核材料，最終促成《禁止化學武器公約》的簽署，以及伊拉克化學武器庫存於一九九〇年代陸續銷毀的過程。軍事技術層面上，「沙漠風暴」確立了精確導引武器、夜間攻擊、隱形機與衛星情報主導的高強度空襲典範；地面作戰則以M1A1的表現重新整理了坦克交戰的距離觀念，遠距毀傷、單向視界與先發現先開火成為此後各國坦克設計與訓練的參照，這套經驗一直延用到二十一世紀的美國裝甲部隊。中東格局層面上，伊拉克軍力被削弱但並未被打垮，海灣國家與美國的長期軍事關係被制度化，聯軍在海灣留下的基地、預置補給與雙邊演訓安排延續數十年。伊拉克國內的分裂也加深了：戰爭結束後南部什葉派地區與北部庫爾德地區先後出現反政府武裝，首都的鎮壓與地方上的自治要求同時存在，中央政府的控制力從此長期受損。軍備管制方面，化學武器作為一整類武器在國際社會的合法性遭到根本性否定，而伊拉克核計畫的核查與轉移則成為此後十餘年國際核查機制最常被引用的範例。
impactEn: The consequences ran to at least four levels. In international law, Security Council resolution 678 established the practice of authorising a multi-national force to use force, and became the United Nations' most frequently cited precedent after the Cold War; resolution 687 then opened the way to large-scale inspection and disarmament of Iraq, creating the Special Commission that checked chemical weapons, missiles and nuclear material, and that process eventually led to the signature of the Chemical Weapons Convention and to the destruction of Iraqi chemical stocks through the 1990s. In military technology, Desert Storm established the canon of high-intensity air power built on precision-guided weapons, night attack, stealth aircraft and satellite intelligence. On the ground, the performance of the M1A1 reorganised the idea of tank engagement range: long-range kill, one-sided vision and shooting first became reference points for tank design and training in every army afterwards, and that experience survives into the American armoured formations of the twenty-first century. In the Middle Eastern balance, the Iraqi army was crippled but not destroyed, and the long-term military relationship between the Gulf states and the United States was institutionalised, with the bases, pre-positioned stocks and bilateral exercise arrangements left in the Gulf continuing for decades. Divisions inside Iraq deepened as well: after the war, armed opposition appeared first in the Shiite areas of the south and then among the Kurds of the north, while repression in the capital and demands for local autonomy existed at the same time, and the central government's grip was damaged for the long term. In arms control, the legal standing of chemical weapons as a whole class was fundamentally negated, and the inspection and removal of the Iraqi nuclear programme became the most frequently cited model for international verification mechanisms of the following decade.
result: 結果以1991年2月28日的停火收束。2月24日至28日的四天地面戰爭中，VII軍在西部沙漠切斷伊拉克退往巴士拉的路線，第十八空降軍在北部突破，第一海軍陸戰隊遠征軍在東線攻下科威特市與艾哈邁德·賈比爾煉油廠區；2月27日第1裝甲師先頭部隊越過科威特城以西的「紅線」，2月28日伊拉克廣播電台宣布停火，聯軍部隊進入科威特並升起國旗，3月2日兩國以安理會第687號決議簽署停火協議。軍事後果具體而慘烈：伊軍撤退時縱貫南北的「死亡高速公路」上，數千輛被遺棄或焚毀的車輛構成沙漠中最慘烈的機械化部隊滅亡場景；伊拉克損失數百輛坦克與裝甲車、數百門火炮與數百架飛機，約六萬五千人被俘；聯軍損失為數百人量級。長期後果同樣清楚：科威特的主權與重建、伊拉克的核查與裁軍程序、1991年起設立並於1992年向北延伸的兩條禁飛區、1991年伊拉克南北方的起義與其後長期存在的聯合國制裁與石油換糧食機制，以及海灣國家在美國主導下進行的重新編組，都由這場戰爭直接引出。
resultEn: The war ended with the ceasefire of 28 February 1991. In the four days of ground fighting from 24 to 28 February, VII Corps cut the road by which Iraq might have withdrawn towards Basra, XVIII Airborne Corps broke through in the north, and I Marine Expeditionary Force took Kuwait City and the Al-Jaber refinery area in the east; on 27 February the lead elements of the 1st Armoured Division crossed the Red Line west of Kuwait City, on 28 February the Iraqi radio announced a ceasefire, coalition troops entered the country and raised the flag, and on 2 March the two states signed the ceasefire under Security Council resolution 687. The military consequences were concrete and grim: along the north-south Highway of Death, thousands of abandoned or burning vehicles formed the most terrible destruction of a mechanised force in the desert; Iraq lost hundreds of tanks and armoured vehicles, several hundred artillery pieces and several hundred aircraft, and about 65,000 men were taken prisoner, while coalition losses were in the hundreds. The long-term consequences are just as clear: the sovereignty and reconstruction of Kuwait, the inspection and disarmament of Iraq, the two no-fly zones established from 1991 and extended northwards in 1992, the uprisings in southern and northern Iraq in 1991 and the sanctions and oil-for-food arrangements that followed, and the reorganisation of the Gulf states under American leadership all followed directly from this war.
